{"name": "ArchVSpace_H.ARM_H.decodeARMMMUInvocation_def__internal__", "statement": "ARM_H.decodeARMMMUInvocation ?label ?args ?x2.0 ?cte ?x4.0
 ?extraCaps \<equiv>
let cap = ?x4.0
in if ARM_H.isPageDirectoryCap cap
   then case (ARM_H.isPDFlushLabel (invocationType ?label), ?args) of
        (True, []) \<Rightarrow>
          throw Fault_H.syscall_error.TruncatedMessage
        | (True, [start]) \<Rightarrow>
            throw Fault_H.syscall_error.TruncatedMessage
        | (True, start # end # x) \<Rightarrow>
            doE whenE (end \<le> start) $
                throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidArgument 1;
                whenE
                 (ARM.pptrBase \<le> VPtr start \<or>
                  ARM.pptrBase < VPtr end) $
                throw Fault_H.syscall_error.IllegalOperation;
                (pd, asid) <-
                case cap of
                ARM_H.PageDirectoryCap pd None \<Rightarrow>
                  throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability 0
                | ARM_H.PageDirectoryCap pd (Some asid) \<Rightarrow>
                    returnOk (pd, asid)
                | _ \<Rightarrow>
                    throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability 0;
                pdCheck <-
                lookupErrorOnFailure False $ ARM_H.findPDForASID asid;
                whenE (pdCheck \<noteq> pd) $
                throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability 0;
                frameInfo <-
                withoutFailure $
                ARM_H.resolveVAddr (ARM_H.capPDBasePtr cap) (VPtr start);
                case frameInfo of
                None \<Rightarrow>
                  returnOk $
                  ARM_H.InvokePageDirectory ARM_H.PageDirectoryNothing
                | Some frameInfo \<Rightarrow>
                    doE withoutFailure $
                        ARM_H.checkValidMappingSize (fst frameInfo);
                        baseStart <-
                        returnOk
                         (ARM_H.pageBase (VPtr start) (fst frameInfo));
                        baseEnd <-
                        returnOk
                         (ARM_H.pageBase (VPtr end - 1) (fst frameInfo));
                        whenE (baseStart \<noteq> baseEnd) $
                        throw $
                        Fault_H.syscall_error.RangeError start $
                        fromVPtr $
                        baseStart +
                        mask (ARM.pageBitsForSize (fst frameInfo));
                        offset <-
                        returnOk
                         (start &&
                          mask (ARM.pageBitsForSize (fst frameInfo)));
                        pStart <- returnOk (snd frameInfo + id offset);
                        returnOk $
                        ARM_H.InvokePageDirectory $
                        ARM_H.PageDirectoryFlush
                         (ARM_H.labelToFlushType ?label) (VPtr start)
                         (VPtr end - 1) pStart pd asid
                    odE
            odE
        | (False, x) \<Rightarrow>
            throw Fault_H.syscall_error.IllegalOperation
   else if ARM_H.isPageTableCap cap
        then case (invocationType ?label, ?args, ?extraCaps) of
             (GenInvocationLabel gen_invocation_labels, b) \<Rightarrow>
               throw Fault_H.syscall_error.IllegalOperation

             | (ArchInvocationLabel ARM_H.ARMPageTableMap, [vaddr],

                 throw Fault_H.syscall_error.TruncatedMessage
             | (ArchInvocationLabel ARM_H.ARMPageTableMap, vaddr # attr # x,

                 throw Fault_H.syscall_error.TruncatedMessage
             | (ArchInvocationLabel ARM_H.ARMPageTableMap, vaddr # attr # x,
                (pdCap, xa) # xb) \<Rightarrow>
                 doE whenE (isJust $ ARM_H.capPTMappedAddress cap) $
                     throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability 0;
                     (pd, asid) <-
                     case pdCap of
                     capability.ArchObjectCap
                      (ARM_H.PageDirectoryCap pd None) \<Rightarrow>
                       throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability 1
                     | capability.ArchObjectCap
                        (ARM_H.PageDirectoryCap pd
                          (Some asid)) \<Rightarrow>
                         returnOk (pd, asid)
                     | capability.ArchObjectCap _ \<Rightarrow>
                         throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability 1
                     | _ \<Rightarrow>
                         throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability 1;
                     whenE (ARM.pptrBase \<le> VPtr vaddr) $
                     throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidArgument 0;
                     pdCheck <-
                     lookupErrorOnFailure False $ ARM_H.findPDForASID asid;
                     whenE (pdCheck \<noteq> pd) $
                     throw $ Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability 1;
                     pdIndex <-
                     returnOk
                      (vaddr `~shiftR~` (pageBits + ARM_H.ptBits -
   ARM_H.pteBits));
                     vaddr' <-
                     returnOk
                      (pdIndex `~shiftL~` (pageBits + ARM_H.ptBits -
     ARM_H.pteBits));
                     pdSlot <-
                     returnOk
                      (pd + (PPtr $ pdIndex `~shiftL~` ARM_H.pdeBits));
                     oldpde <- withoutFailure $ getObject pdSlot;
                     unlessE (oldpde = ARM_H.InvalidPDE) $
                     throw Fault_H.syscall_error.DeleteFirst;
                     pde <-
                     returnOk
                      (ARM_H.PageTablePDE
                        (addrFromPPtr $ ARM_H.capPTBasePtr cap)
                        (ARM_H.armParityEnabled $
                         ARM_H.attribsFromWord attr)
                        0);
                     returnOk $
                     ARM_H.InvokePageTable $
                     ARM_H.PageTableMap
                      (capability.ArchObjectCap $
                       ARM_H.capPTMappedAddress_update
                        (\<lambda>_. Just (asid, VPtr vaddr')) cap)
                      ?cte pde pdSlot
                 odE
             | (ArchInvocationLabel ARM_H.ARMPageTableUnmap, x,
                xa) \<Rightarrow>
                 doE cteVal <- withoutFailure $ getCTE ?cte;
                     final <- withoutFailure $ isFinalCapability cteVal;
                     unlessE final $
                     throw Fault_H.syscall_error.RevokeFirst;
                     returnOk $
                     ARM_H.InvokePageTable $ ARM_H.PageTableUnmap cap ?cte
                 odE
             | (ArchInvocationLabel _, b) \<Rightarrow>
                 throw Fault_H.syscall_error.IllegalOperation
        else if ARM_H.isPageCap cap

                     xa) \<Rightarrow>
                      throw Fault_H.syscall_error.TruncatedMessage
                  | (ArchInvocationLabel ARM_H.ARMPageMap,

                  | (ArchInvocationLabel ARM_H.ARMPageMap,

                          case ARM_H.capVPMappedAddress cap of

                                  whenE (vaddr' \<noteq> VPtr vaddr) $

                          vmRights <-
                          returnOk
                           (ARM_H.maskVMRights (ARM_H.capVPRights cap) $
                            rightsFromWord rightsMask);
                          ARM_H.checkVPAlignment (ARM_H.capVPSize cap)
                           (VPtr vaddr);
                          entries <-
                          ARM_H.createMappingEntries
                           (addrFromPPtr $ ARM_H.capVPBasePtr cap)
                           (VPtr vaddr) (ARM_H.capVPSize cap) vmRights
                           (ARM_H.attribsFromWord attr) pd;
                          ARM_H.ensureSafeMapping entries;
                          returnOk $
                          ARM_H.InvokePage $
                          ARM_H.PageMap asid
                           (capability.ArchObjectCap $
                            ARM_H.capVPMappedAddress_update
                             (\<lambda>_. Just (asid, VPtr vaddr)) cap)
                           ?cte entries
                      odE
                  | (ArchInvocationLabel ARM_H.ARMPageUnmap, x,

                      returnOk $ ARM_H.InvokePage $ ARM_H.PageUnmap cap ?cte

                      ARM_H.decodeARMPageFlush ?label ?args cap

                     xa) \<Rightarrow>
                      ARM_H.decodeARMPageFlush ?label ?args cap
                  | (ArchInvocationLabel ARM_H.ARMPageCleanInvalidate_Data,
                     x, xa) \<Rightarrow>
                      ARM_H.decodeARMPageFlush ?label ?args cap

                      returnOk $
                      ARM_H.InvokePage $
                      ARM_H.PageGetAddr (ARM_H.capVPBasePtr cap)

                      throw Fault_H.syscall_error.IllegalOperation

                          index # depth # x,
                          (untyped, parentSlot) #
                          (croot, xa) # xb) \<Rightarrow>
                           doE asidTable <-
                               withoutFailure $

                               returnOk
                                (filter
                                  (\<lambda>(x, y).
x \<le> HaskellLib_H.bit ARM_H.asidHighBits - 1 \<and> isNothing y) $

                               whenE (null free) $

  returnOk $ capPtr untyped
                                    odE
                               else throw $
                                    Fault_H.syscall_error.InvalidCapability
                                     1;

ksArchState);

 (ARM_H.asidHighBitsOf base));
                                    whenE (isNothing poolPtr) $
                                    throw $
                                    Fault_H.syscall_error.FailedLookup False
                                     Fault_H.lookup_failure.InvalidRoot;
                                    p <- liftME the $ returnOk poolPtr;
                                    whenE
                                     (p \<noteq> ARM_H.capASIDPool cap) $
                                    throw $

 (\<lambda>(x, y).

assocs pool);
                                    whenE (null free) $

{"name": "Untyped_H.invokeUntyped_def", "statement": "invokeUntyped ?x0.0 \<equiv>
case ?x0.0 of
Invocations_H.untyped_invocation.Retype srcSlot reset base retypeBase
 newType userSize destSlots isDev \<Rightarrow>
  doE whenE reset $ resetUntypedCap srcSlot;
      withoutPreemption $
      do totalObjectSize <-
         return
          (length destSlots `~shiftL~` getObjectSize newType userSize);
         inRange <-
         return
          (\<lambda>x.
              fromPPtr retypeBase \<le> x \<and>
              x \<le> fromPPtr retypeBase + fromIntegral totalObjectSize -

         stateAssert (\<lambda>s. \<not> archOverlap s inRange) [];
         haskell_assert (canonicalAddressAssert retypeBase) [];
         freeRef <-
         return (retypeBase + PPtr (fromIntegral totalObjectSize));

         createNewObjects newType srcSlot destSlots retypeBase userSize
          isDev
      od
  odE"}

{"name": "ArchVSpace_H.ARM_H.findPDForASID_def", "statement": "ARM_H.findPDForASID ?asid \<equiv>
doE haskell_assertE (0 < ?asid) [];
    haskell_assertE (?asid \<le> snd ARM_H.asidRange) [];
    asidTable <-
    withoutFailure $ gets (ARM_H.armKSASIDTable \<circ> ksArchState);
    poolPtr <- returnOk (asidTable (ARM_H.asidHighBitsOf ?asid));
    pool <-
    liftME (inv ARM_H.ASIDPool) $
    case poolPtr of
    None \<Rightarrow> throw Fault_H.lookup_failure.InvalidRoot
    | Some ptr \<Rightarrow> withoutFailure $ getObject ptr;
    pd <- returnOk (pool (?asid && mask ARM_H.asidLowBits));
    case pd of None \<Rightarrow> throw Fault_H.lookup_failure.InvalidRoot
    | Some ptr \<Rightarrow> doE haskell_assertE (ptr \<noteq> 0) [];
                                 withoutFailure $ ARM_H.checkPDAt ptr;
                                 returnOk ptr
                             odE
odE"}
{"name": "ArchVSpace_H.ARM_H.writeITASIDPool_def", "statement": "writeITASIDPool ?apCap ?pdCap \<equiv>
do apPtr <-
   case ?apCap of
   capability.ArchObjectCap (ARM_H.ASIDPoolCap ptr x) \<Rightarrow>
     return ptr
   | capability.ArchObjectCap _ \<Rightarrow> haskell_fail []
   | _ \<Rightarrow> haskell_fail [];
   pdPtr <-
   case ?pdCap of
   capability.ArchObjectCap (ARM_H.PageDirectoryCap ptr x) \<Rightarrow>
     return ptr
   | capability.ArchObjectCap _ \<Rightarrow> haskell_fail []
   | _ \<Rightarrow> haskell_fail [];
   ap <- liftM (inv ARM_H.ASIDPool) $ getObject apPtr;
   ap' <- return (ap aLU [(itASID, Just pdPtr)]);
   setObject apPtr (ARM_H.ASIDPool ap');
   asidTable <- gets (ARM_H.armKSASIDTable \<circ> ksArchState);
   asidTable' <-
   return (asidTable aLU [(ARM_H.asidHighBitsOf itASID, Just apPtr)]);
   modify
    (\<lambda>s. s
        \<lparr>ksArchState :=
                  ARM_H.armKSASIDTable_update (\<lambda>_. asidTable')
                   (ksArchState s)\<rparr>)
od"}
{"name": "Thread_H.tcbQueueRemove_def", "statement": "tcbQueueRemove ?queue ?tcbPtr \<equiv>
do tcb <- getObject ?tcbPtr;
   beforePtrOpt <- return $ tcbSchedPrev tcb;
   afterPtrOpt <- return $ tcbSchedNext tcb;
   if tcbQueueHead ?queue = Just ?tcbPtr \<and>
      tcbQueueEnd ?queue = Just ?tcbPtr
   then return $ TcbQueue Nothing Nothing
   else if tcbQueueHead ?queue = Just ?tcbPtr
        then do haskell_assert (afterPtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
                threadSet (tcbSchedPrev_update (\<lambda>_. Nothing))
                 (fromJust $ afterPtrOpt);
                threadSet (tcbSchedNext_update (\<lambda>_. Nothing))
                 ?tcbPtr;
                return $
                tcbQueueHead_update (\<lambda>_. afterPtrOpt) ?queue
             od
        else if tcbQueueEnd ?queue = Just ?tcbPtr
             then do haskell_assert (beforePtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
                     threadSet (tcbSchedNext_update (\<lambda>_. Nothing))
                      (fromJust $ beforePtrOpt);
                     threadSet (tcbSchedPrev_update (\<lambda>_. Nothing))
                      ?tcbPtr;
                     return $
                     tcbQueueEnd_update (\<lambda>_. beforePtrOpt) ?queue
                  od
             else do haskell_assert (afterPtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
                     haskell_assert (beforePtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
                     threadSet
                      (tcbSchedNext_update (\<lambda>_. afterPtrOpt))
                      (fromJust $ beforePtrOpt);
                     threadSet
                      (tcbSchedPrev_update (\<lambda>_. beforePtrOpt))
                      (fromJust $ afterPtrOpt);
                     threadSet (tcbSchedPrev_update (\<lambda>_. Nothing))
                      ?tcbPtr;
                     threadSet (tcbSchedNext_update (\<lambda>_. Nothing))
                      ?tcbPtr;
                     return ?queue
                  od
od"}
{"name": "Thread_H.tcbQueueInsert_def__internal__", "statement": "tcbQueueInsert ?tcbPtr ?afterPtr \<equiv>
do tcb <- getObject ?afterPtr;
   beforePtrOpt <- return $ tcbSchedPrev tcb;
   haskell_assert (beforePtrOpt \<noteq> Nothing) [];
   beforePtr <- return $ fromJust beforePtrOpt;
   haskell_assert (beforePtr \<noteq> ?afterPtr) [];
   threadSet (tcbSchedPrev_update (\<lambda>_. Just beforePtr)) ?tcbPtr;
   threadSet (tcbSchedNext_update (\<lambda>_. Just ?afterPtr)) ?tcbPtr;
   threadSet (tcbSchedPrev_update (\<lambda>_. Just ?tcbPtr)) ?afterPtr;
   threadSet (tcbSchedNext_update (\<lambda>_. Just ?tcbPtr)) beforePtr
od"}
